jobs.how: BO 1 is the BMS auto/stop; at Auto the chiller runs when its own run conditions are met. Run Enabled, Running State and Running Mode show the result.

points.use: Write Active = Auto, Inactive = Stop; check it's writable on the controller
Read whether the chiller is available to run
Read running state, Active = On
Read running mode: 1 Off, 2 Start, 3 Run

jobs.how: Write the mode to MO 1 and confirm it on MI 2 Operating Mode.

points.use: Write 1 Cool, 2 Heat, 3 Ice; check it's writable on the controller
Read operating mode: 1 Cool, 2 Heat, 3 Ice

jobs.how: Write the chilled or hot water setpoint and read the active setpoint back. If Local Setpoint Control is active, the chiller is using local setpoints instead of the BAS values.

points.use: Write chilled water setpoint, 0-75 °F; check it's writable on the controller
Write hot water setpoint, 80-140 °F; check it's writable on the controller
Read the active chilled or hot water setpoint
Read Active = Local Control, Inactive = Remote Control

jobs.how: Limit capacity with the demand limit setpoint and read actual running capacity. Capacity Limited and Maximum Capacity show when the chiller cannot reach setpoint or is using everything it has.

points.use: Write demand limit, 0-120 %; check it's writable on the controller
Read active demand limit setpoint
Read actual running capacity %
Read Active = capacity limited
Read Active = all available capacity in use

jobs.how: Read entering and leaving evaporator water temperatures and flow status. Water Pump Request is the chiller's request to turn on the water pump.

points.use: Read evaporator entering water temperature
Read evaporator leaving water temperature
Read evaporator water flow, Active = Flow
Read water pump request, Active = On
Read outdoor air temperature

jobs.how: Request heat recovery or reduced noise with the BOs and read the matching status points. Points that don't apply to the unit's configuration are absent.

points.use: Write Active = Heat Recovery; check it's writable on the controller
Write heat recovery leaving water setpoint, 80-140 °F; check it's writable on the controller
Read heat recovery control active
Read heat recovery leaving water temperature
Write Active = Reduced Noise; check it's writable on the controller
Read noise reduction active

jobs.how: Each compressor has a running BI, a starts count and a run time; each circuit has suction and discharge pressure. Objects for parts not fitted are absent.

points.use: Read compressor 1A running
Read compressor 1A starts
Read compressor 1A run time
Read circuit 1 suction pressure
Read circuit 1 discharge pressure
Read Active = one or more circuits in defrost

jobs.how: BI 23 is the summary alarm; this list has no per-alarm diagnostic objects. BO 2 remotely resets diagnostics that can be reset.

points.use: Read summary alarm, Active = Alarm
Read shutdown alarm present
Read last diagnostic
Write Active = Reset Request; check it's writable on the controller

checklist: Confirm the chiller uses this short-instance list (AI 1, AO 1, BO 1) and not the standard Symbio 800 CGAM list with 5-digit AV/BV/MV objects.
For MS/TP, land on the P1 link and set the rotary address to 001-127 (it ships at 000, which disables MS/TP, at 76,800 bps); this also sets the Device ID.

For BACnet IP use Ethernet port 1 on UDP 47808, set a software Device ID if needed through the web UI over USB at http://198.80.18.1/, and enable BBMD only if it is the only BACnet IP device on the subnet.
Discover the chiller and read BI 1 (Run Enabled), BI 4 (Chiller Running State), MI 1 (Running Mode) and AI 45 (Evaporator Leaving Water Temp), noting the units are fixed I-P or SI from the factory.
Check BI 2 (Local Setpoint Control) reads Inactive = Remote Control before relying on BAS setpoints.
Check AO 1 (Chilled Water Setpoint) is writable, write a test value and confirm AI 1 (Active Cool/Heat Setpoint Temperature) follows.
Test BO 1 (Chiller Auto Stop Command) at Stop and back to Auto while watching BI 4 and MI 1.
Remember that on release BO 1 goes to Auto, AO 1 to 44 °F and AO 3 to 100 %, so the chiller can run on its own conditions.
Map BI 23 (Alarm Present) and BI 24 (Shutdown Alarm Present) as alarms, and use BO 2 (Remote Diagnostic Reset Command) only for resettable diagnostics.
